name: tandem-markdown
description: A WYSIWYG markdown editor for VS Code with support for a wide range of markdown syntax styles. You can keep a note open while an AI agent works on the same file, or while someone else's changes come in through a sync tool, a shared folder or git.
author: Fort Whimsy LLC

tandemMarkdown.defaultRichMode.description: Which rich view Switch View and Reopen With open first.

tandemMarkdown.contentWidth.description: Width of the text column in pixels. Use 0 for the full width of the tab.

tandemMarkdown.fontSize.description: Size of the text in pixels.

tandemMarkdown.fontFamily.description: Font for the text. Leave empty to use the system font.

tandemMarkdown.lineHeight.description: Line height for the text, as a multiple of the font size.

tandemMarkdown.table.alignOnEdit.description: Pad every row of a table so its columns line up after a cell is edited. This rewrites the whole table in the file.

enumDescriptions: Keep your words there. The other program's version goes to a backup, and a message says so.
Keep the other program's words there. A copy of your text goes to a backup, and a message says so.
tandemMarkdown.outsideChanges.whenBothCh.description: What to keep where you and another program both change the same words in a note.

tandemMarkdown.outsideChanges.highlight.description: Highlight each line another program changes, with an outline that stays until you have seen it.

tandemMarkdown.outsideChanges.announce.description: Tell your screen reader when another program changes a note you have open in the Rich editor or the Rich view.

enumDescriptions: As a table of names and values
As the text in the file

tandemMarkdown.frontmatter.display.description: How the front matter block at the top of a file is shown.

tandemMarkdown.images.allowRemote.description: Show pictures from https addresses, in markdown and in HTML, and play video and sound from them while tandemMarkdown.syntax.media is on.

tandemMarkdown.maxRichFileSizeKb.description: Files larger than this many kilobytes open in the rich views with drawing turned off.

tandemMarkdown.scrollSync.description: Scroll the visible tabs of a note together once one of them is a rich view. Each note starts this way; the button in its tabs' title bars, or Toggle Scroll Sync, links or unlinks them for that note until the window closes. A note visible only in Source starts unlinked.

tandemMarkdown.changeMarks.description: In the Rich editor's margin, mark the lines added, changed and removed since the file's last commit in git.

tandemMarkdown.hideBuiltInPreviewButtons.description: Hide VS Code's built-in Markdown preview buttons in the editor title bar and Explorer menu so Tandem Markdown's view buttons replace them. VS Code's built-in preview commands and shortcuts still work.

markdownEnumDescriptions: `[[note|shown text]]`, as Obsidian, Foam and Bear write them.
`[[shown text|note]]`, as Dendron and GitLab wikis write them.
tandemMarkdown.syntax.wikilinks.markdownDescription: Draw `[[wikilinks]]` as links, and pictures embedded with `![[picture.png]]`: `noteFirst` reads the note before the bar, as Obsidian, Foam and Bear write them; `textFirst` reads the shown text first, as Dendron and GitLab wikis do; `off` shows them as typed.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.footnotes.markdownDescription: Draw footnotes: a reference, `[^1]`, as its note's number, the note numbered where it stands, and notes written in place, `^[text]`.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.tags.markdownDescription: Draw `#tags` as labels, by Obsidian's rule (a color code such as `#ff0000` is a tag; `#123` is not). Ctrl+click (Cmd+click on a Mac) searches the workspace for the tag.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.emoji.markdownDescription: Draw emoji codes on GitHub's list, such as `:smile:`, as the emoji.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.callouts.markdownDescription: Draw GitHub's alerts and Obsidian's callouts, `> [!NOTE]`, as boxes. Off shows them as quotes.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.math.markdownDescription: Draw math: `$…$` in a line (prices such as `$5 and $10` stay text), `$$…$$` blocks and `math` code blocks.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.pictureSizes.markdownDescription: Draw a picture at the size written in braces after it, `![](pic.png){width=50%}` (Pandoc, Quarto, GitLab), or after its alt text and a bar, as Obsidian writes it.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.otherPictureSizes.markdownDescription: Read a picture's size written after its address, `![](pic.png =300x200)` (Azure DevOps), and in Logseq's braces, `![](pic.png){:height 200, :width 300}`.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.media.markdownDescription: Play video and sound files from the workspace where a file has `<video>` or `<audio>`, an embed such as `![[talk.ogg]]`, or a link to one written as a picture, `![demo](demo.mp4)`. Nothing plays by itself; files from https addresses only while `tandemMarkdown.images.allowRemote` is on.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.themePictures.markdownDescription: Show a picture whose address ends in `#gh-dark-mode-only` or `#only-dark` only with a dark theme, and one ending in `#gh-light-mode-only` or `#only-light` only with a light theme (GitHub, Material for MkDocs).

tandemMarkdown.syntax.mermaid.markdownDescription: Draw `mermaid` code blocks as Mermaid diagrams.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.contents.markdownDescription: Draw `[TOC]`, `[toc]`, `[[_TOC_]]` or `[[toc]]` (VitePress, in any letter case) on a line of its own as a list of the file's headings. `[[toc]]` stays a link when a note named toc answers it.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.embeds.markdownDescription: Draw a note embedded with `![[Note]]`, `![[Note#Heading]]` or `![[Note#^id]]` on a line of its own as that note, its section or its block, read-only. Needs wikilinks.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.blockIds.markdownDescription: Fade a block id such as `^quote-1` at the end of a paragraph in Rich editor, and hide it in Rich view.

markdownEnumDescriptions: `H~2~O` and `x^2^` as subscript and superscript, as Pandoc draws them, and any other `~text~` struck through, as GitHub draws it.
`~text~` struck through, as GitHub draws it.
`H~2~O` and `x^2^` as subscript and superscript, as Pandoc draws them.
tandemMarkdown.syntax.tilde.markdownDescription: How to read a pair of single tildes or carets. `both` reads each pair as the program that writes it means it: one straight after a letter, a digit or a closing bracket (`)`, `]` or `}`) with no space inside (`H~2~O`, `x~i~`, `x^2^`) is subscript or superscript, as Pandoc, Quarto, Typora and Joplin read them, and any other `~text~` is struck through by GitHub's rule, so `~5 to ~10` stays text; `strikethrough` strikes every `~text~` through, as GitHub does; `subscript` reads every pair with no space inside as subscript or superscript, as Pandoc does; `off` shows them as typed. A space escaped with a backslash counts as no space, an escaped tilde or caret is text, and nothing in code is read. Two tildes always strike through.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.comments.markdownDescription: Fade Obsidian's comments, `%%text%%` and blocks between `%%` lines, in the Rich editor, and hide them in Rich view.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.taskMarks.markdownDescription: Draw tasks with another mark in the box, such as `- [?]` and `- [-]` (Obsidian), as boxes showing the mark. A click does not check them.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.highlightColors.markdownDescription: Draw a highlight whose text starts with a color emoji, such as `==🔴Important==`, in that color, the emoji hidden (Obsidian's six colors; Bear writes five of them).

tandemMarkdown.syntax.boxes.markdownDescription: Draw `:::` blocks (Pandoc, Quarto, VitePress, Docusaurus) and `!!!` admonitions (MkDocs) as boxes; a name such as `note` or `warning` gives a callout's look, and `??? note` folds.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.headingAttributes.markdownDescription: Hide attributes in braces after a heading, `## Title {#intro}` (Pandoc, kramdown, Hugo), and take the `#id` as the heading's link address.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.spans.markdownDescription: Draw Pandoc's styled spans, `[text]{.underline}`, `{.smallcaps}` and `{.mark}`, and hide the bookmarks Word leaves, `[]{#_Toc12 .anchor}`, which links still jump to.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.tomlFrontmatter.markdownDescription: Draw TOML front matter, between `+++` lines at the top of a file (Hugo), as a table, as YAML front matter is drawn.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.jsonFrontmatter.markdownDescription: Draw JSON front matter at the top of a file, between `;;;` lines (GitLab) or as a bare `{…}` object (Hugo), as a table.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.definitionLists.markdownDescription: Draw definition lists, a term on its own line and then `: Its definition` (Pandoc, PHP Markdown Extra, kramdown), with the term in bold.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.gridTables.markdownDescription: Draw Pandoc's grid tables, ruled with lines such as `+------+------+`, as tables. Their cells can hold paragraphs and lists, and are edited in the source.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.abbreviations.markdownDescription: Read abbreviation definitions, `*[HTML]: Hyper Text Markup Language` (PHP Markdown Extra, Python-Markdown, kramdown): the abbreviation shows what it stands for as a tooltip wherever it appears, and the definition is left out of Rich view.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.codeFenceLabels.markdownDescription: Read a code block's language from braces or words after its fence (`{.python}`, `{r}`, `js{1,4}`), as Pandoc, Quarto and VitePress write it, and show a `title="…"` it gives in its header.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.latexMath.markdownDescription: Draw math in LaTeX's delimiters: `\(…\)` in a line and `\[…\]` as a paragraph of its own, as chat assistants write them, and environments such as `\begin{align}` (Jupyter). Drawn while `math` is on.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.doubledLatexMath.markdownDescription: Draw math written with doubled backslashes, `\\(…\\)` and `\\[…\\]`, as MultiMarkdown and Jupyter write it. Drawn while `math` is on.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.criticMarkup.markdownDescription: Draw tracked-change marks (CriticMarkup, as MultiMarkdown writes them): `{++added++}`, `{--deleted--}`, `{~~old~>new~~}`, `{==marked==}` and `{>>comments<<}`.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.contentTabs.markdownDescription: Draw MkDocs content tabs, `=== "Tab"` over an indented body, each as a box under its title. Drawn while `boxes` is on.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.fencedQuotes.markdownDescription: Draw GitLab's quote between `>>>` lines as a quote. Drawn while `boxes` is on.

tandemMarkdown.syntax.conflictMarkers.markdownDescription: Draw git's conflict markers, a block from a `<<<<<<<` line to a `>>>>>>>` line, as one conflict with its sides labeled and buttons to keep either side or both. Off, the lines are read as any other markdown.

tandemMarkdown.conflictFiles.description: When Tandem Markdown cannot settle another program's change to a note, write it up in a conflict file beside the note (for Field notes.md, Field notes.md.conflict), where an AI agent can read it and act on it. When off, no conflict file is written; backups are kept either way.
